reference: By ten he will have been reheating noodles for two hours straight.
sk: Do desiatej už bude zohrievať rezance dve hodiny v kuse.
cz: Do desíti už bude ohřívat nudle dvě hodiny v kuse.
acceptable: {By ten|By ten o'clock} he will have been {reheating|heating|heating up|warming up} {noodles|the noodles} {for |}two hours {straight|nonstop}.
{By ten|By ten o'clock} he will have been {reheating|heating up|warming up} {noodles|the noodles} for two hours {in a row|without a break}.
He will have been {reheating|heating up|warming up} {noodles|the noodles} for two hours {straight|nonstop} by ten {o'clock|}.

mistakes.text: By ten he will be reheating noodles {for |}two hours straight.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Trvanie až do budúceho bodu („by ten“) vyjadruje Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Trvání až do budoucího bodu („by ten“) vyjadřuje Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Duration up to a future point (“by ten”) needs the Future Perfect Continuous: “will have been reheating”.

mistakes.text: By ten he will have reheated noodles {for |}two hours straight.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dôraz je na nepretržitom trvaní, preto je lepší Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Důraz je na nepřetržitém trvání, proto je lepší Future Perfect Continuous: „will have been reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The focus is on non-stop duration, so the Future Perfect Continuous “will have been reheating” is better.

mistakes.text: By ten he will have been reheat noodles {for |}two hours straight.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „will have been“ patrí tvar s -ing: „reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „will have been“ patří tvar s -ing: „reheating“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “will have been” you need the -ing form: “reheating”.

mistakes.text: By ten he will have been reheating noodles since two hours.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dĺžke trvania patrí „for“, nie „since“: „for two hours“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U délky trvání patří „for“, ne „since“: „for two hours“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “for” with a length of time, not “since”: “for two hours”.

mistakes.text: Until ten he will have been reheating noodles {for |}two hours straight.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Do desiatej“ ako časový bod je „by ten“, nie „until ten“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Do desíti“ jako časový bod je „by ten“, ne „until ten“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a point in time the action leads up to, use “by ten”, not “until ten”.
